<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

:root{
  --black:oklch(0% 0 0);
  --green:oklch(78% 0.18 155);
  --purple:oklch(35% 0.25 285);
  --purple-light:oklch(45% 0.22 285);
  --coral:oklch(72% 0.19 35);
  --yellow:oklch(88% 0.15 85);
  --navy:oklch(18% 0.03 265);
  --navy-light:oklch(24% 0.03 265);
  --white:oklch(100% 0 0);
  --off-white:oklch(97% 0.005 265);
  --gray-100:oklch(95% 0.005 265);
  --gray-200:oklch(90% 0.008 265);
  --gray-300:oklch(80% 0.01 265);
  --gray-400:oklch(65% 0.01 265);
  --gray-500:oklch(50% 0.01 265);
  --gray-600:oklch(35% 0.015 265);
  --gray-700:oklch(25% 0.015 265);
  --text-primary:oklch(15% 0.01 265);
  --text-secondary:oklch(40% 0.01 265);
  --radius-sm:8px;
  --radius-md:12px;
  --radius-lg:16px;
  --radius-xl:24px;
  --radius-full:9999px;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / .06);
  --shadow-md:0 4px 12px oklch(0% 0 0 / .08);
  --shadow-lg:0 8px 30px oklch(0% 0 0 / .12);
  --shadow-xl:0 16px 50px oklch(0% 0 0 / .16);
  --font-display:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Inter','Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --transition-fast:150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  --transition-base:250ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  --transition-slow:400ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:var(--font-body);color:var(--text-primary);background:var(--white);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none}
ul,ol{list-style:none}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6{font-family:var(--font-display);line-height:1.15;font-weight:800}

.container{width:100%;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
@media(min-width:768px){.container{padding:0 40px}}
@media(min-width:1024px){.container{padding:0 48px}}

/* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
.header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:oklch(18% 0.03 265 / .95);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / .06)}
.header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
@media(min-width:768px){.header-inner{padding:0 40px}}
.logo{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--white);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.logo-icon{width:32px;height:32px;background:var(--green);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);display:grid;place-items:center}
.logo-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.header-nav{display:none;align-items:center;gap:32px}
@media(min-width:768px){.header-nav{display:flex}}
.header-nav a{color:oklch(80% 0.01 265);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;transition:color var(--transition-fast)}
.header-nav a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.btn-signin{color:oklch(80% 0.01 265);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);transition:color var(--transition-fast);display:none}
@media(min-width:480px){.btn-signin{display:block}}
.btn-signin:hover{color:var(--white)}
.btn-signup{background:var(--green);color:var(--black);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:700;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);transition:transform var(--transition-fast),box-shadow var(--transition-fast)}
.btn-signup:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 20px oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .4)}

/* ==================== HERO ==================== */
.hero{background:var(--navy);padding:120px 0 80px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:90vh;display:flex;align-items:center}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-200px;right:-200px;width:600px;height:600px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .25),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-150px;left:-100px;width:500px;height:500px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .12),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto}
.hero-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:oklch(100% 0 0 / .08);border:1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / .1);color:var(--green);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);margin-bottom:28px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-badge span{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4rem);color:var(--white);margin-bottom:20px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.08}
.hero h1 .highlight{color:var(--green);position:relative}
.hero-subtitle{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.5vw,1.3rem);color:oklch(75% 0.01 265);margin-bottom:40px;font-weight:500}
.hero-cta-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto 32px}
@media(min-width:480px){.hero-cta-group{flex-direction:row;max-width:520px;gap:16px}}
.btn-google,.btn-email{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:16px 28px;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;transition:transform var(--transition-fast),box-shadow var(--transition-fast);flex:1}
.btn-google{background:var(--white);color:var(--text-primary)}
.btn-google:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px oklch(0% 0 0 / .25)}
.btn-google svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.btn-email{background:var(--green);color:var(--black)}
.btn-email:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .4)}
.btn-email svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.hero-legal{font-size:.72rem;color:oklch(55% 0.01 265);max-width:440px;margin:0 auto 48px;line-height:1.55}
.hero-legal a{color:oklch(70% 0.01 265);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:oklch(70% 0.01 265 / .3)}
.hero-legal a:hover{color:var(--white)}

.category-pills{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;justify-content:flex-start}
.category-pills::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
@media(min-width:1024px){.category-pills{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;overflow-x:visible}}
.pill{white-space:nowrap;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;background:oklch(100% 0 0 / .07);color:oklch(80% 0.01 265);border:1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / .08);transition:all var(--transition-fast);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.pill:hover,.pill.active{background:var(--green);color:var(--black);border-color:var(--green)}

/* ==================== FEATURES ==================== */
.features{padding:100px 0;background:var(--white)}
.section-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--purple);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:16px}
.section-label::before{content:'';width:20px;height:2px;background:var(--purple);border-radius:2px}
.section-title{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--text-primary)}
.section-subtitle{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-secondary);max-width:580px;line-height:1.7}
.features-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:64px}
.features-header .section-subtitle{margin:0 auto}
.features-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:600px){.features-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.features-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.feature-card{background:var(--off-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:36px 28px;text-align:center;transition:transform var(--transition-base),box-shadow var(--transition-base);border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.feature-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.feature-icon{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 20px;font-size:1.6rem}
.feature-card:nth-child(1) .feature-icon{background:oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .15);color:oklch(60% 0.18 155)}
.feature-card:nth-child(2) .feature-icon{background:oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .12);color:oklch(50% 0.22 285)}
.feature-card:nth-child(3) .feature-icon{background:oklch(72% 0.19 35 / .15);color:oklch(62% 0.19 35)}
.feature-card:nth-child(4) .feature-icon{background:oklch(88% 0.15 85 / .2);color:oklch(65% 0.15 85)}
.feature-card h3{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--text-primary)}
.feature-card p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.6}

/* ==================== STATS ==================== */
.stats{background:var(--navy);padding:80px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.stats::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .1),transparent 50%,oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .08))}
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:32px;position:relative;z-index:2}
@media(min-width:768px){.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:48px}}
.stat-item{text-align:center}
.stat-number{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.4rem);font-weight:800;color:var(--white);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1}
.stat-number .accent{color:var(--green)}
.stat-label{font-size:.9rem;color:oklch(65% 0.01 265);margin-top:6px;font-weight:500}
.stat-item:nth-child(4) .stat-number{color:var(--yellow)}

/* ==================== COURSES ==================== */
.courses{padding:100px 0;background:var(--off-white)}
.courses-header{margin-bottom:48px}
.course-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:12px;margin-top:32px;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}
.course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tab-btn{white-space:nowrap;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);transition:all var(--transition-fast);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--text-primary);border-color:var(--gray-300)}
.tab-btn.active{background:var(--purple);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--purple)}
.course-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:600px){.course-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.course-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:1100px){.course-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.course-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;transition:transform var(--transition-base),box-shadow var(--transition-base);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);cursor:pointer}
.course-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)}
.course-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.course-thumb-bg{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--white);padding:16px;text-align:center;line-height:1.4}
.course-card:nth-child(1) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(55% 0.22 320),oklch(65% 0.2 350))}
.course-card:nth-child(2) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(50% 0.18 260),oklch(60% 0.2 290))}
.course-card:nth-child(3) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(60% 0.15 180),oklch(70% 0.18 155))}
.course-card:nth-child(4) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(55% 0.2 285),oklch(45% 0.22 265))}
.course-card:nth-child(5) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(65% 0.18 40),oklch(72% 0.2 25))}
.course-card:nth-child(6) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(50% 0.15 200),oklch(60% 0.18 230))}
.course-card:nth-child(7) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(60% 0.2 350),oklch(55% 0.22 15))}
.course-card:nth-child(8) .course-thumb-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(70% 0.15 85),oklch(65% 0.18 60))}
.course-duration{position:absolute;bottom:10px;right:10px;background:oklch(0% 0 0 / .75);color:var(--white);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.course-info{padding:18px}
.course-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.35;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.course-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-secondary)}
.course-instructor{font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary)}
.course-students{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.course-students svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--gray-400)}

/* ==================== CREATIVE FEED ==================== */
.creative-feed{padding:100px 0;background:var(--white)}
.feed-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:768px){.feed-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px}}
.feed-visual{position:relative}
.feed-mockup{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--navy),oklch(22% 0.04 285));border-radius:var(--radius-xl);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:24px;gap:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)}
.feed-card-mock{background:oklch(100% 0 0 / .07);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:16px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.feed-avatar-mock{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.feed-card-mock:nth-child(1) .feed-avatar-mock{background:var(--coral)}
.feed-card-mock:nth-child(2) .feed-avatar-mock{background:var(--green)}
.feed-card-mock:nth-child(3) .feed-avatar-mock{background:var(--purple-light)}
.feed-lines{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.feed-line{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:oklch(100% 0 0 / .1)}
.feed-line:nth-child(1){width:60%}
.feed-line:nth-child(2){width:85%}
.feed-line:nth-child(3){width:45%}
.feed-img-mock{height:80px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(72% 0.19 35 / .3),oklch(88% 0.15 85 / .3));margin-top:8px}
.feed-points{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:32px}
.feed-point h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--text-primary)}
.feed-point h3 span{color:var(--purple)}
.feed-point p{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.65}

/* ==================== TEACHERS ==================== */
.teachers{padding:100px 0;background:var(--off-white)}
.teachers-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:56px}
.teachers-header .section-subtitle{margin:0 auto}
.teacher-carousel-wrap{position:relative}
.teacher-carousel{display:flex;gap:24px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;padding:8px 0 16px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.teacher-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.teacher-card{flex:0 0 260px;scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;transition:transform var(--transition-base),box-shadow var(--transition-base);border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.teacher-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.teacher-avatar{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.teacher-avatar-bg{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--white)}
.teacher-card:nth-child(1) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(60% 0.18 320),oklch(50% 0.2 350))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(2) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(55% 0.2 260),oklch(45% 0.22 285))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(3) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(65% 0.16 155),oklch(55% 0.18 180))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(4) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(62% 0.2 35),oklch(52% 0.22 15))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(5) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(60% 0.15 200),oklch(50% 0.18 230))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(6) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(70% 0.18 85),oklch(60% 0.2 60))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(7) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(55% 0.22 285),oklch(65% 0.18 310))}
.teacher-card:nth-child(8) .teacher-avatar-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,oklch(50% 0.16 165),oklch(60% 0.14 145))}
.teacher-info{padding:20px}
.teacher-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);margin-bottom:4px}
.teacher-specialty{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text-secondary);font-weight:500}
.carousel-nav{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin-top:32px}
.carousel-btn{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--gray-300);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all var(--transition-fast);color:var(--text-secondary)}
.carousel-btn:hover{border-color:var(--purple);color:var(--purple);background:oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .06)}
.carousel-btn svg{width:20px;height:20px}

/* ==================== TESTIMONIALS ==================== */
.testimonials{padding:100px 0;background:var(--white)}
.testimonials-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:56px}
.testimonial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:600px){.testimonial-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.testimonial-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.testimonial-card{background:var(--off-white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:32px 24px;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);transition:transform var(--transition-base),box-shadow var(--transition-base)}
.testimonial-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
.testimonial-stars{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--yellow)}
.testimonial-stars svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:oklch(82% 0.16 85)}
.testimonial-text{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:20px;font-style:italic}
.testimonial-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.testimonial-avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--white)}
.testimonial-card:nth-child(1) .testimonial-avatar{background:var(--green)}
.testimonial-card:nth-child(2) .testimonial-avatar{background:var(--purple-light)}
.testimonial-card:nth-child(3) .testimonial-avatar{background:var(--coral)}
.testimonial-card:nth-child(4) .testimonial-avatar{background:oklch(55% 0.2 260)}
.testimonial-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary)}
.testimonial-role{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-secondary)}

/* ==================== TEAMS ==================== */
.teams{padding:100px 0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),oklch(22% 0.05 285));position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.teams::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-100px;right:-100px;width:400px;height:400px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .15),transparent 70%)}
.teams::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-100px;left:-50px;width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .25),transparent 70%)}
.teams-content{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;max-width:700px;margin:0 auto}
.teams .section-label{color:var(--green)}
.teams .section-label::before{background:var(--green)}
.teams .section-title{color:var(--white)}
.teams-text{font-size:1.05rem;color:oklch(75% 0.01 265);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:40px}
.btn-teams{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--green);color:var(--black);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;padding:16px 36px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);transition:transform var(--transition-fast),box-shadow var(--transition-fast)}
.btn-teams:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px oklch(78% 0.18 155 / .35)}
.btn-teams svg{width:18px;height:18px;transition:transform var(--transition-fast)}
.btn-teams:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}

/* ==================== FAQ ==================== */
.faq{padding:100px 0;background:var(--off-white)}
.faq-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:56px}
.faq-list{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-item{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow var(--transition-base)}
.faq-item.open{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:oklch(35% 0.25 285 / .2)}
.faq-question{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 28px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);text-align:left;transition:color var(--transition-fast);gap:16px}
.faq-question:hover{color:var(--purple)}
.faq-icon{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gray-100);display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;transition:all var(--transition-base)}
.faq-item.open .faq-icon{background:var(--purple);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-icon svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--text-secondary);transition:color var(--transition-base)}
.faq-item.open .faq-icon svg{color:var(--white)}
.faq-answer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height var(--transition-slow);padding:0 28px}
.faq-answer-inner{padding:0 0 24px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.75}

/* ==================== FOOTER ==================== */
.footer{background:var(--black);padding:80px 0 0;color:oklch(70% 0.01 265)}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:32px 24px;margin-bottom:64px}
@media(min-width:600px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:1100px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}}
.footer-col-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:16px}
.footer-col ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.footer-col a{font-size:.85rem;color:oklch(60% 0.01 265);transition:color var(--transition-fast)}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--green)}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / .08);padding:28px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:768px){.footer-bottom{flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between}}
.footer-logo{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--white);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.footer-logo .logo-icon{width:28px;height:28px}
.footer-legal{font-size:.78rem;color:oklch(50% 0.01 265);text-align:center;max-width:600px;line-height:1.55}
@media(min-width:768px){.footer-legal{text-align:right}}

/* ==================== ANIMATIONS ==================== */
.fade-up{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .6s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94),transform .6s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)}
.fade-up.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.fade-up.delay-1{transition-delay:.1s}
.fade-up.delay-2{transition-delay:.2s}
.fade-up.delay-3{transition-delay:.3s}
.fade-up.delay-4{transition-delay:.4s}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  // Scroll-triggered fade animations
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      }
    });
  },{threshold:0.1,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});

  document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up').forEach(function(el){
    observer.observe(el);
  });

  // Category pills
  document.querySelectorAll('.category-pills .pill').forEach(function(pill){
    pill.addEventListener('click',function(){
      document.querySelectorAll('.category-pills .pill').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active')});
      this.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // Course category tabs
  var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.course-card');

  tabs.forEach(function(tab){
    tab.addEventListener('click',function(){
      tabs.forEach(function(t){t.classList.remove('active')});
      this.classList.add('active');
      var category = this.getAttribute('data-tab');

      cards.forEach(function(card){
        var cats = card.getAttribute('data-category');
        if(category === 'featured' || cats.indexOf(category) !== -1){
          card.style.display = '';
          card.style.opacity = '0';
          card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
          requestAnimationFrame(function(){
            requestAnimationFrame(function(){
              card.style.transition = 'opacity .35s ease, transform .35s ease';
              card.style.opacity = '1';
              card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            });
          });
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });

  // Teacher carousel
  var carousel = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  var scrollAmount = 284;

  if(prevBtn && nextBtn && carousel){
    prevBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      carousel.scrollBy({left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth'});
    });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      carousel.scrollBy({left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth'});
    });
  }

  // FAQ accordion
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var item = this.parentElement;
      var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function(fi){
        fi.classList.remove('open');
        fi.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        fi.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = null;
      });

      if(!isOpen){
        item.classList.add('open');
        this.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
        answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });

  // Header scroll effect
  var header = document.querySelector('.header');
  var lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    if(scrollTop > 100){
      header.style.background = 'oklch(12% 0.02 265 / .98)';
    } else {
      header.style.background = 'oklch(18% 0.03 265 / .95)';
    }
    lastScroll = scrollTop;
  },{passive:true});
})();
</script>

</html>
